Pruning is important because it helps plants stay healthy, safe, and visually appealing. Removing dead, diseased, or damaged branches improves air circulation and sunlight penetration, which can reduce the risk of fungal diseases and pest problems. It also encourages stronger new growth and can improve flowering, fruit production, and overall plant structure. For ornamental shrubs and trees, pruning helps maintain shape and size so plants don’t become overgrown or interfere with walkways, siding, roofs, or utility lines. In landscapes, regular pruning also improves curb appeal and keeps beds looking clean and maintained. Different plants benefit from pruning at different times of year. For example, many spring-flowering shrubs should be pruned shortly after they bloom, while many shade trees are best pruned during dormancy. Proper pruning techniques are important too — making clean cuts in the right locations helps plants heal more effectively and prevents unnecessary stress.#greenwich #connecticut #landscaping #pruning #bedford

Sweet Peet mulch is a premium, all-natural mulch made from composted organic materials, and it offers a range of benefits for both plant health and overall landscape quality. Unlike traditional wood mulches, it’s rich in nutrients, which means it not only protects your soil but actively improves it over time. As it breaks down, Sweet Peet enhances soil structure, promotes beneficial microbial activity, and helps retain moisture—reducing the need for frequent watering. Its dark, uniform color gives beds a clean, high-end appearance while also helping to suppress weeds naturally. Because it’s finely processed, it spreads easily and won’t wash away as quickly in heavy rain, making it a reliable and long-lasting option for maintaining a polished, healthy landscape.#connecticut #greenwich #landscaping #spring #mulch
